transcript: 1. good morning eighth graders quiet please I have the field trip details
2. we're going to the Harbor Science Center on Pier Road on Thursday November thirteenth
3. the buses leave school at eight fifteen so be in homeroom by eight
4. we'll be back by three thirty so you can still catch your regular bus
5. the cost is eighteen dollars and the money is due Wednesday November fifth
6. give it to Mr Pruitt in the front office not to me
7. do we need a permission slip
8. yes the green form it's in your folder and it's due with the money
9. what about lunch
10. bring a brown bag lunch no glass bottles and nothing that needs a fridge
11. there's a planetarium show at eleven twenty and everyone has to be in the lobby by eleven ten
12. we need four parent chaperones and I only have two signed up
13. if your parents can help have them email me by Friday
14. red team goes with Ms Okonkwo and blue team with me
15. green and yellow teams are still waiting for chaperones
16. can we bring phones
17. yes but only for photos and they stay in your bag in the planetarium
